function vq_guard_acquire() {
    global $wpdb;
    return '1' === (string) $wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare(

    global $wpdb;
    $wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare('SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(%s)', $wpdb->prefix . 'vq_booking_guard'));
}
